PokeM_LogCabin.title: Log cabin
PokeM_LogCabin.drawn: The log cabin by the marsh: a steep gable roof of grey slates with its ridge front to back under a raised ridge cap, log walls whose side logs run out past the corners in round ends, a gable of dark boards over a light beam with a king post and rafters, the plank door and a window of two panes.

PokeM_Lodge.title: Lodge
PokeM_Lodge.drawn: Two copies, each cut off by the image's edge: at the bottom left the front but for its left end, at the bottom only the roof, whole across. A skirt roof of brown boards over a dark fascia round cream brick walls between big timber corner posts, an upper part of light boards under a low gable roof with a light ridge board, a window and the door between two posts under a porch beam.
